pages.title: Dimensional Singularity
pages.text: Eleven dimensions, with all their compactified circles, branes and moduli, compressed into a point with none at all. It is impossible to say which way it faces. Even the space around it seems to lose a direction or two when it is near.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I gave the Compressor everything that held the extra dimensions in place: Kaluza-Klein shards, the dilaton, moduli, a D-brane, a penteract and a Calabi-Yau. Every dimension curled up until none remained.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Theory of Everything.
